differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned at a high angle, looking down at the tiles with a relatively flat perspective.
differences.b_observable: The camera is positioned at a much lower, oblique angle, creating a steep perspective where the tiles recede sharply.
differences.fix: Adjust the camera's pitch and height to match the flatter, high-angle perspective of the reference video.

differences.a_observable: The shadows cast by the elevated cards onto the background tiles are dark, distinct, and have sharp contact edges.
differences.b_observable: The shadows cast by the elevated cards are extremely soft, diffuse, and light, lacking definition and depth.
differences.fix: Increase the shadow density or reduce the light source radius to create sharper, darker contact shadows.

differences.a_observable: The blue shield icon has a deep, saturated royal blue color.
differences.b_observable: The blue shield icon has a lighter, less saturated sky blue color.
differences.fix: Adjust the color grading or material diffuse color of the blue elements to match the deeper royal blue of the reference.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera angle and height to match the flatter, high-angle perspective of the reference video, which will correct the overall layout and framing of the tiles.
